answer: Topological Entropy Credit: each agent’s weight is the entropy of its interaction paths across disjoint ASN/prefix, latency, and adjacency fingerprints from randomized orchard/opal/velvet probe classes. Sybil clusters routed through shared infrastructure produce correlated fingerprints, collapsing their effective weight. Attacker must rent many independent network vantage points and sustain low-latency, churn-resistant adjacency—costlier than minting keys.
